title: stephanotis macrantha
intro: Stephanotis macrantha, commonly known as the stephanotis or wedding flower, is a flowering plant native to Madagascar, belonging to the Apocynaceae family. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness due to its sedative and calming effects. The health benefits of Stephanotis macrantha are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids and flavonoids, which have therapeutic actions that include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. Regular use of Stephanotis macrantha may help to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and improve overall well-being.
